capabilities: Render numpad notation as directional arrows
Show motion inputs and button icons
Display badges for DR, DRC, DI, Super Arts and hit states
Support prefixes, separators, charge inputs and dashes
Render each line of a code block as its own combo
disambiguation: Not a game engine or move-list manager; it only styles notation text you type into code blocks.
extras: Supports ```fg and ```fg-sf6 code blocks (Street Fighter 6). Unrecognized input falls back to plain text. Runs offline with no network requests. Credits button icons to Lorc (game-icons.net, CC BY 3.0) and separator icons to Lucide (ISC).
problem: Plain-text fighting game inputs like 236LP or j.HP are hard to read in notes, and Obsidian has no way to display them as arrows and button icons.
summary: Plugin that renders fighting game combo notation written in fenced code blocks as styled blocks with directional arrows, button icons and badges.
